main_members.name: Prachi Dwivedi
main_members.bio:
Meet Prachi Dwivedi, a social entrepreneur, and a passionate leader. She founded Kadam Foundation (2020), Samanvay Youth Conclave (1000+ participants in August), and serves as CEO of Aatmdhaar, empowering women in rural areas. She also leads as Director of the Covid Patient Help Desk.
An active member of RSS (Nagar Karwahika) and ABVP (Adhyaksha), she is a certified life coach and an experienced debater with 30+ Youth Parliament & MUN roles. In her free time, she explores photography, capturing memories one click at a time.

story_cards.title: Cleaning the Streets of Bhopal
story_cards.excerpt: 80+ volunteers joined our city-wide cleanliness drive and planted saplings across public spaces.

story_cards.title: Skills That Changed Lives
